hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: Coworker MCP is the source of truth for this company's internal knowledge: people, teams, decisions, projects, customers, and what anyone is working on, via the OM2 knowledge graph and the work tools the company has connected (individual_context lists them). The Coworker server's own instructions carry the tool order and the routing map by question shape - follow them: OM2 tools before any connector, past-chat memory, or general knowledge; individual_context once before the first connector call; never fabricate internal facts, and cite the Coworker source. Every Coworker tool takes a `timezone` argument: detect it once (macOS `readlink /etc/localtime | sed 's|.*/zoneinfo/||'`, Linux `cat /etc/timezone`) and pass it on every call. Playbooks: skill_retrieve mcp-company-data-cascade (search order) and mcp-om2-usage (OM2 tools); skill_search for other tasks.
